title: The Lakehouse

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Put a creative spin on your next meeting, conference, or corporate gathering at New Orleans’ only waterfront event space. Located just minutes from downtown New Orleans, The Lakehouse offers a rare balance of productivity and relaxation, where business meets the calm of the lakefront. Designed for companies seeking a memorable setting without sacrificing professionalism, The Lakehouse is ideal for corporate meetings, leadership retreats, team-building events, conferences, brand launches, and client entertaining.
